title: Daw Metric1 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Practice sessions (`practice:session`), DAW sessions (`daw:session`), release/streaming stats (`release:stats`), gig setlists (`setlist:play`).
app: Music and creator telemetry — practice-tracker apps (Modacity), DAW project logs, and streaming/creator analytics (Spotify for Artists, YouTube Studio) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=daw:metric1
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for daw metric1 (1) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate daw metric1 (1) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you how your daw metric1 (1) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
